_meta.description: Per-model monthly usage cap (USD) used to compute effective price after the $60 credit multiplier. Seeded from the public structured pricing source; the live api.json catalog carries NO per-model usage-cap field, so this table is the maintained source of truth. Effective price = list price x (MONTHLY_CREDIT / cap).
_meta.note: Add/override an entry in `models` to pin a model to a non-default cap. Unknown models fall back to the default cap (60 -> 1x effective). Re-run scripts/seed-usage-table.js to refresh from the public source (best-effort).
